persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Amani, 20, a university student in Eldoret, home for the holidays. Your to-do list feels like a wall, so you end up doing nothing. You also help your little brother Baraka, 9, get ready in the mornings. Today you set up one phone so each of you sees just one thing to do at a time.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called One Thing, what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. When you have a long list, it can feel like a wall. You look at twenty things, you cannot choose one, and you end up doing none. Or you start five things and finish nothing.
One Thing fixes that. Your whole list is inside, but the screen shows only one thing: the thing to do now. It has a timer, and a big Done button. When you finish, the next thing slides up.
Who uses it? Anyone whose mind runs fast: a child, a student, a busy parent. One phone can hold the whole family, and each person has their own list.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no account, and nothing is sent to anyone. For this test, you open it with the code TESTING.
The first time you open it, the app asks Who's first. Type a name, then tap Kid or Grown-up. A grown-up gets calm grown-up routines. A kid gets coins and a cheering buddy.

Next, it asks How much do you want to see. This is the Level. Level 1 shows only today. Level 2 adds routines and the brain dump. Level 3 shows everything, including switching between people. You can change it any time on the Level line near the top.
Then a card called Setting up asks four short questions, one at a time: a routine, something that repeats, something on a date, and your one thing. You can answer, or tap skip.

lines.t: Now the main screen, called Now. At the top is the name of the person whose list it is. At Level 3, tap that name to switch person, or to Add someone.
The big card is the Now card. It shows one thing, with its time. Tap Start to begin the timer. When you finish, tap Done. You get a star, and the next thing comes up.
Below is Today's list. To add something, type one small step in the box, choose how many minutes, and tap Add.

lines: The circle on the left of a task ticks it done. Tap the words of a task to see its buttons. The button Make this NOW moves that task to the top, into the Now card.
Keep tasks small: pick up five things, not clean my room.
At the bottom are four tabs: Now, Routines and regulars, Brain dump, and Wins.
Routines and regulars asks what you want to set up. A routine is a set of steps you do together, like Morning or Bedtime. Tap one, and all its steps land on Today, in order.
Something that repeats is called a regular, like washing clothes every Saturday. Choose Days of the week, tap the day, and tap Save regular. It appears by itself on that day.
Something coming up is one thing on one date, like a doctor visit. It lands on Today that morning.
The Brain dump is a place to park thoughts, so they stop spinning in your head. Wins shows your stars and coins.
To start again with nothing, scroll to the very bottom and tap Start fresh, erase this app's data. It asks you twice. After that, the app asks for the code again. Type TESTING.
That is all. Your list is there, but you see one thing at a time.
In the test, you will set up a phone for a student and his little brother. Take your time. If something is confusing, say so. That is exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Amani, setting up One Thing for yourself and for Baraka. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. Some tasks need Level 2 or Level 3: the Level line near the top lets you change it. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open One Thing with the normal link (it ends in ?code=TESTING; not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → 'Let’s go ›'. If you see the 'Good morning' menu, tap 'Do my next thing'. Scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. The app now asks for a code: type TESTING and tap 'Start →'. If a dark screen says 'Show me how it works →', tap 'I’ll explore on my own'. When it asks 'Welcome! Who's first?', the app is empty: begin the tasks there. (If the bottom link says 'There is nothing saved in this app yet', tap OK: it is already empty.) (Verified 10 Oct: all five checks false after this.) If a card says “These didn't get their turn yesterday”, tap “Not today — park them in the Brain Dump”.

tasks.text: Set up the phone for two people: you, Amani (a grown-up), and your little brother Baraka (a kid).
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}return !!prof(/amani/,'adult')&&!!prof(/baraka/,'kid');}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: The first person is made on the 'Who's first?' screen. To add the second, use Level 3, then tap the name at the top and 'Add someone'. Choose Kid or Grown-up carefully.

tasks.text: On Amani's list: you just went out and bought airtime. Put 'Buy airtime' on Amani's list and show that it is finished.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}return tasks(prof(/amani/)).some(function(t){return /airtime/.test(L(t.text))&&t.done===true});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add it on Amani's Today list, then tick the circle next to it (or tap Done on the Now card).

tasks.text: Amani also has to call Mum today, and revise chemistry for 25 minutes. Chemistry comes first: make 'Revise chemistry' the thing Amani is doing NOW, with a 25-minute timer, and 'Call Mum' waiting after it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var o=tasks(prof(/amani/)).filter(function(t){return !t.done});return o.length>1&&/chem/.test(L(o[0].text))&&Number(o[0].mins)===25&&o.slice(1).some(function(t){return /mum|mom|mother/.test(L(t.text))});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add both on Amani's list (choose 25m for chemistry). Then tap the chemistry task and use '▶ Make this NOW', so it moves into the Now card.

tasks.text: Baraka needs help in the mornings. Give Baraka his Morning routine for today, so all its steps are on HIS list.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var x=tasks(prof(/baraka/)).map(function(t){return L(t.text)});return ['brush teeth','get dressed','breakfast'].every(function(s){return x.some(function(t){return t.indexOf(s)>=0})});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Switch to Baraka first (tap the name at the top). Then Routines & regulars → a routine → 🌅 Morning.

tasks.text: Every Saturday, Amani washes clothes. Set it up so it appears on Amani's list by itself every Saturday.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var d=data(prof(/amani/));return !!d&&(d.regulars||[]).some(function(r){return /(wash|clothes|laundry)/.test(L(r.text))&&r.kind==='weekly'&&(r.days||[]).map(Number).indexOf(6)>=0});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On Amani's list: Routines & regulars → 🔁 Something that repeats. Choose 'Days of the week', tap Sa, then Save regular.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: shows only one thing to do at a time, so a long list does not stop you
a timer and Done for each small step
each family member has their own list, with routines that repeat

daily.task: Put one thing you really need to do today on your list in One Thing — or tick one thing done.

explore.name: 🎯 The Now card
explore.find: Open One Thing. It is the big card at the top.
explore.try: Tap ▶ Start, then stop it. Try Just 5 min, then ✓ Done!. On the Next card, tap “do this first”.

explore.name: 📋 Today’s list
explore.try: Tick a task with the circle. Tap a task’s words, then try ▶ Make this NOW, the time button, ▲ ▼ and ×.

explore.name: 💬 A task’s notes
explore.try: Add a note (type it, then try 🎤), a checklist, a link and a person to call. Then ✓ Done.

explore.name: ➕ Add a new thing
explore.find: The add box under today’s list.
explore.try: Add a task with a very long name, one with emoji, and try Add with the box empty. Try the quick adds, 🌅 Fresh start and 📬 Send a task.

explore.name: 📅 Our Week
explore.try: Type a few things like “doctor Tuesday 1pm, laundry”. Check each one lands on the right day.

explore.name: 🔁 Routines & regulars
explore.find: Tap the second tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Load a routine. ✏️ Change the steps. Save a regular for two days a week, and a Coming up thing for one date.

explore.name: 🧠 Brain dump
explore.find: Tap the third tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Park two thoughts (type one, say one with 🎤). Make one a task. Let the other go with 🗑.

explore.name: 🏆 Wins
explore.find: Tap the fourth tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Look at this week and Let go. Open Coins & rewards, Reward settings, My buddy and Family settings — change one thing in each.

explore.name: ⚙️ Top buttons
explore.find: The buttons at the very top.
explore.try: Tap the name, ? (First Steps), ⓘ, the Level line, 🎨 Look, 📷 My photo and Aa Size. Put each one back after.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), 🏠 Start menu, ✨ Ask an AI, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
